en: A vintage, hand‑tinted postcard. The front shows a green lawn at the foot of rocky hills, with scattered groups of women and children walking or playing, many in long skirts or traditional dress. Behind them are trees and a few buildings, including a tower‑like structure and pavilions, all set against a rocky hillside under a blue sky with some clouds. The caption is printed in Hungarian at the top left, with additional handwritten Hungarian text across the sky. The reverse side is divided for address and message, densely filled with handwritten Hungarian text. Numerous Hungarian stamps marked "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA" are affixed, each denominated in fillér, and postmarks are visible.
